notes.title: Update January 24th
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31653099/89c376a28a7c14256cd823cb1be9b5bfee07eb65.png[/img]
Fat Foods should now be available in all regions for purchase! 

* The Main Menu has been update with the active levels getting a face-lift.

* All player cameras now contain all the control info needed to play.

* We are still working on Vive and WMR support.

Please contact us here on Steam or email support@team21studio.com with any questions or concerns.

Thank you from everyone at Team 21!
